events.verdict: Randle (NOP) and Jordan (DAL) engage and disengage at the top of the perimeter.
Davis (NOP) makes marginal contact with Barnes' (DAL) right shoulder as he begins his upward shooting motion.
Barnes (DAL) legally uses a hand and a bent forearm to defend Randle (NOP) in the post.
[Observable in enhanced video] Randle (NOP) lifts and re-plants his pivot foot prior to his shot attempt.
Matthews (DAL) makes marginal contact with Holiday (NOP) as the shot is released and does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Moore (NOP) wraps Jordan (DAL) off-ball as he rolls into the lane.

Davis (NOP) makes marginal contact with Doncic's (DAL) head/neck area after the release of his shot attempt. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Jordan (DAL) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Randle (NOP) makes marginal contact with Doncic's (DAL) off-arm prior to the release of his shot attempt.
Davis (NOP) makes incidental foot contact with Doncic (DAL) during rebounding that causes him to fall to the floor and on top of Doncic.
Randle (NOP) delivers contact to Barea (DAL) that dislodges him from his legally obtained defensive position.
Matthews (DAL) is already in Moore's (NOP) defensive path when the incidental contact takes place along the perimeter as the two players switch.
MOB/RAR show Randle (NOP) makes contact across Barea's (DAL) front and to his head/neck area as he attempts to make the pass.
Holiday (NOP) makes clean contact with the ball as the pass intended for Jordan (DAL) is made.
Barea (DAL) makes contact with Randle's (NOP) arm during his upward shooting motion and affects the shot.
[Observable in enhanced video] Doncic (DAL) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
[Observable in enhanced video] Jordan (DAL) is in the lane for longer than three seconds.
Randle (NOP) makes body to body contact with Doncic (DAL) that affects his SQBR. RAR shows that the illegal contact occurs just prior to Doncic's gather and is correctly called a personal foul.
Randle (NOP) establishes himself in a screening position in Jordan's (DAL) defensive path and absorbs contact as it is made.
Jordan (DAL) makes marginal contact with Davis's (NOP) right arm after the release of his jump shot attempt that does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
Miller (NOP) moves into Doncic's (DAL) body and initiates contact that causes him to lose control of the ball.
Moore (NOP) makes marginal contact with Matthews (DAL) during rebounding.
Randle (NOP) firms up in his screening position in Jordan's (DAL) defensive path and absorbs contact as it is made along the perimeter.
Randle (NOP) briefly places his arm around Finney-Smith's (DAL) midsection as the pick is set before correcting.
